captureRule: A-9 capture by summing to ten / 10-K capture by rank / only red cards (H, D) score
landscapeBanner: Rotate your device for a better view of the cards
hint.play: this card captures the most points

tutorial.capture: There are two capture rules and they do not overlap: A-9 pair to ten, 10-K pair by rank. A nine cannot take another nine, and a ten cannot take a numeral.
tutorial.layout: The centre is the layout. Play a card that pairs with one of them and you take both.
tutorial.flip: After you play, a card is turned from the stock and captures on the same terms. That is why there is no redeal -- hand and stock empty together.
tutorial.red: Only the red cards score. Those are the ones showing a number; black cards are worth nothing however many you take.
tutorial.tie: The red cards are worth 210 between them, so 105 draws and 106 wins.

blocked.noMatch: This card cannot be taken (A-9 pair to ten, 10-K match rank)
